original_model_proposal.reasoning_summary: The best matches are for the exact Japanese SV2a Charizard ex 201/165 holofoil/SAR printing. A TCGplayer-derived market reference around $388.35 and recent Near Mint Japanese sales around $390-$392 cluster tightly, while LastSold shows a raw paid-sales-derived market price of $390.28. Because the requested card is explicitly NM and the matching sources align on the same printing, I used those condition-specific references to estimate a current item-only NM market value near $390.
assumptions: The requested 'Pokemon Card 151' refers to the Japanese SV2a set and the 201/165 Charizard ex SAR/holofoil printing shown in the sources.
The condition match is Near Mint and the listed references are sufficiently representative of NM raw copies.
Shipping, tax, and grading premiums/discounts are excluded.
limitations: Source pages are aggregators, not direct marketplace exports; market-reference figures are therefore secondary.
One source reports a raw market price without explicitly stating Near Mint, so it is supportive but not purely condition-specific.
No directly verified live asking-price snapshot was available in the gathered sources.
